network.note: 109 = count of links referenced by project6_v8_storage_retrofit_control_enabled_ids.txt plus links that appear in native [CONTROLS] but not in Engineering36.

dynamic_internal_rules.description: Prefix replay of internal baseline up to checkpoint, then native [CONTROLS] govern all 82 native-rule facilities.
dynamic_internal_rules.prefix_behavior: external override writes target_setting from baseline a: columns
dynamic_internal_rules.post_checkpoint_behavior: native [CONTROLS] compute actions from live depth/flow state; NO external override

no_control.description: All 109 controllable facilities held at setting=1.0 (fully open) for entire simulation.
no_control.prefix_behavior: external override writes 1.0 for all 109 facilities
no_control.post_checkpoint_behavior: external override continues writing 1.0 for all 109 facilities
no_control.note: Uses no-controls INP to ensure no native rules interfere. All 109 facilities explicitly set to 1.0.

hold_internal_snapshot.description: Prefix replay of internal baseline up to checkpoint, then freeze ALL 82 native-rule facilities at their checkpoint current_setting for the remainder.
hold_internal_snapshot.prefix_behavior: external override writes same baseline a: values as dynamic_internal
hold_internal_snapshot.post_checkpoint_behavior: external override writes CONSTANT setting vector (read from baseline current_setting at checkpoint)
hold_internal_snapshot.freeze_scope: 82 native-rule facilities only; non-controlled facilities remain at initial 1.0

hold_previous.description: Prefix replay of internal baseline up to checkpoint-5min, then freeze at that setting for the remainder.
hold_previous.prefix_behavior: external override writes frozen baseline (values at checkpoint-5min held constant from that point)
hold_previous.post_checkpoint_behavior: external override continues writing same frozen values

causal_intervention.description: Single actuator set to low/high while all others follow baseline. Tests causal link between action and flow/node state.
causal_intervention.controlled_facilities: 1 selected actuator at low/high; remaining 81 native-rule facilities follow baseline

shared_prefix_contract.description: All branches must share identical actual action sequence from event start to checkpoint.
requirements: Same physical network (physical_network_sha256 must match, ignoring CONTROLS/RAINGAGES/TIMESERIES/dates)
Same checkpoint state hashes (node depth, head, flooding, storage volume, link flow, actuator settings)
shared_prefix_contract.prefix_source: native_internal_run1_detail.csv (baseline trajectory with controls, internal_rules policy)

physical_network_sha256_policy.description: SHA256 computed after stripping [CONTROLS], [RAINGAGES], [TIMESERIES], and OPTIONS start/end dates.
physical_network_sha256_policy.purpose: Verify that with-controls and no-controls INP have identical physical network structure

formal_blacklist.description: Events from formal_v31_design rainfall library must not be used in Gate 2.5-real-v2.
formal_blacklist.note: The V1 primary event V31_RP10_D5H_P35_v31_independent_gamma_108 is from the rainfall library used by formal experiments and must be flagged.

scope_conflict_resolution.resolution: 54 non-Eng36 facilities are governed by native [CONTROLS] in the Dynamic Internal branch. In no_control/hold_snapshot/hold_previous branches, these facilities follow their initial INP settings (typically 1.0) since [CONTROLS] are stripped. This is explicit and documented, not ambiguous.
